title: Free Days Out With Kids in the USA: Museums, Parks & More
description: Free family days out across the USA: Smithsonian museums, Museums on Us weekends, Museums for All, library museum passes, national park fee-free days and more.
h1: Free days out with kids in the USA
intro: From the Smithsonian to your local library’s museum pass, there are plenty of ways for American families to enjoy great days out for free. Here’s where to start.

blocks.title: Scout’s US savings stack
blocks.text: Ask your local library first. Many lend free or discounted passes to nearby museums, zoos and aquariums, and few families know about them.
points: Museums on Us: first full weekend of every month
Museums for All: show an EBT card

sections.html: Most Smithsonian museums in Washington, DC are free, including the National Museum of Natural History and the National Air and Space Museum. Some use free timed-entry passes at busy times. si.edu

sections.h2: Bank of America Museums on Us
sections.html: On the first full weekend of every month, Bank of America, Merrill and Bank of America Private Bank cardholders get one free general admission at participating museums. Bring your card and photo ID. It covers the cardholder only, not guests. The next dates are 7–8 November and 5–6 December 2026. Find participating museums
Families receiving SNAP benefits can show an EBT card for free or reduced admission at hundreds of participating museums nationwide. museums4all.org

• Library museum passes: many public libraries lend passes for local attractions.
  • National parks: the NPS publishes fee-free days each year. Fourth graders get a free Every Kid Outdoors pass.
  • State and city parks, beaches and playgrounds are free year-round.

faqs.q: When is Bank of America Museums on Us?
faqs.a: The first full weekend of every month. For late 2026, that’s 7–8 November and 5–6 December. Check Bank of America’s site in case dates change.
Yes. Admission to most Smithsonian museums is free, though some require free timed-entry passes at busy times.
